properties.markdown: **How to read this dashboard.** Rates are fleet totals per second. Gauges marked *fleet* are time-averaged fleet totals; *hottest pod* is the single largest pod sample. Durations are means only: histogram min/max/percentiles are not exported to CloudWatch. MiB = 1,048,576 bytes. Pod counts *reporting telemetry* are derived from the 1 s export interval; a drop means pods stopped exporting, not that work stopped. Proxy panels are empty when the capture proxy is scaled to 0.

metrics.expression: (SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,method,qualifier,sourceStatusCode,statusCodesMatch,targetStatusCode} MetricName="tupleComparison" OTelLib="replayer" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER"', 'Sum', 60)) + FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,method,qualifier,statusCodesMatch,targetStatusCode} MetricName="tupleComparison" OTelLib="replayer" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER"', 'Sum', 60)), 0)) / 60

properties.markdown: These panels cover the complete Migration Assistant-managed Kafka cluster; no broker-volume selection is required. Fleet disk and inode utilization are capacity-weighted five-minute views. Free space and abnormal health retain per-volume legends to expose imbalance or a specific failing volume. Missing inode or abnormal-health data means the kubelet/CSI driver did not publish that metric; it is not treated as zero or healthy.

metrics.expression: 100 * (1 - SUM(FILL(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,EKSClusterName,qualifier,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim} EKSClusterName="EKS_CLUSTER_NAME" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" namespace="MA_NAMESPACE" MetricName="kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes"', 'Minimum', 300), REPEAT)) / SUM(FILL(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,EKSClusterName,qualifier,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim} EKSClusterName="EKS_CLUSTER_NAME" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" namespace="MA_NAMESPACE" MetricName="kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes"', 'Maximum', 300), REPEAT)))
metrics.label: Fleet utilization

properties.markdown: One-minute managed-broker JMX metrics exported to CloudWatch. Request/error dimensions are limited to Produce, FetchConsumer, and FetchFollower; topic and partition labels are not exported. Kafka 4.0 combined-role brokers report the request-handler idle fractions for both broker and controller pools, so the saturation panel normalizes their sum by two.
